---
title: "8: How the Public Perceives Courts"
---

Courts are often said to hold a "reservoir of goodwill" that lets them prevail even when their decisions are unpopular. But where does public support for courts come from? This week we seek to understand the sources of judicial legitimacy amongst the public, from legal symbols to partisanship and ideology.
